input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only assignment provision (no change-of-control language appears anywhere). It fails the fallback on material terms: there is no successor/M&A carve-out for either party, no written-notice mechanic, and no reasonableness standard on the consent that is required; the retained mutual no-consent affiliate exception also means not every non-successor assignment requires consent. We therefore redline to the preferred position: Client may assign freely to an affiliate or an M&A successor, TrueLink may assign only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a Client competitor, and a Client change of control gives TrueLink no termination right. This preserves our existing affiliate freedom rather than trading it away for the mutual fallback.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.

proposal.summary: Make assignment asymmetric: Client free to assign to affiliates/successors; TrueLink assignment needs Client consent (not unreasonably withheld), never to a competitor; no termination on Client change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need freedom to assign to an affiliate or an M&A successor, while TrueLink may assign only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to our competitor, and a change of control of Client must not give TrueLink a termination right.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Client may assign its rights under this Agreement without approval to an affiliate or a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer its rights without Client's prior written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and shall not assign to a Client competitor.

ops.text: A change of control of Client shall not give TrueLink any right to terminate this Agreement.
